home.title: Glasses that last. Renaissance Eyewear
home.description: French eyewear maison, born in 2019. 18KT gold-plated titanium, Mazzucchelli acetate. Every pair carries its number engraved on the bridge. What you wear. What you hand down.

shop.title: All creations
shop.description: The Renaissance Eyewear catalog reads like a timeline: each model carries a Roman numeral, each pair its number engraved on the bridge. 18KT gold-plated titanium, Mazzucchelli acetate.

heritage.title: Heritage Collection
heritage.description: The Heritage collection by Renaissance Eyewear. The trident: three points, a single shaft. 18KT gold-plated titanium. Shapes that move through the fashions without bending to them.

versailles.title: Versailles Collection
versailles.description: The Versailles collection by Renaissance Eyewear. The fleur de lys: three petals, a single binding. 18KT gold-plated titanium, hand-polished. Brilliance without excess.

isis.title: Isis Collection
isis.description: The Isis collection by Renaissance Eyewear. The ankh, the scarab, the cobra, the Eye of Horus. Signs that cross five thousand years, engraved in titanium.

histoire.title: Our Story
histoire.description: Born in 2019 from a refusal: the refusal to watch what should last disappear. Three men of the trade, brothers by choice. What you wear. What you hand down.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact Renaissance Eyewear. A question, a piece of advice, an adjustment. Every request gets an answer.
